<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex013052025-11-2612-07-48" status="reviewed" part="M" next="ex013052025-11-2612-14-48">
         <milestone n="Conclusive verses (47a5-47a6)" unit="section"/>
         <milestone n="V.1" unit="section"/>   
         <lg><l><lb n="47a5"/> shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo' dang bstan bcos las ||</l> <l>yongs bsdu' rnams thams cad mkhyen nyid lam ||</l> <l>rten dang sems bskyed tshogs gnyis sgrub pa can ||</l> <l>'di ni sangs rgyas sras po'i bya bar stan ||</l> </lg> <note type="translation">[Śāntideva] showed this path, which is the road to the omniscient consciousness that is well gathered from the Great extant sūtra (Vaipulyasūtra) and the treatises and is achieving two accumulations of support (rten) and mind-generation (sems bskyed), as the behavior of the Buddha's son.</note>
          <milestone n="V.2" unit="section"/> 
         <lg><l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3839">bdag</rs> gis 'gro la phan blos 'bad pa yis ||</l> <l>rgyal sras spyod pa'i tshig don gsal byas pa'i ||</l> <l>dge' ba 'di <lb n="47a6"/> <choice><corr>yis</corr><sic>pa'i</sic></choice> theg mchog lam zhugs pa'i ||</l> <l>gzhung 'di rnyed nas 'jug cing brtan pa shog ||</l></lg> ||<note type="translation">Having this virtue of making clear the words and [those] meaning in terms of his behavior of the Conqueror's son (=Boddhisattvacāryāvatāra) by means of my heartfelt effort [urging] sentient beings' benefit by me, 
May wish that [those] entering the path of the supreme vehicle encounter this text before entering and that [their] practice would be stable.
</note> </seg></TEI>
